messages:

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Overdue invoices: INV-2026-331 + outstanding balance

Hi Elena / Cortex billing team,

Following up on previous reminders — our records show an outstanding balance of EUR 84,750 across invoices INV-2026-331 (90 days overdue) and INV-2027-015 (30 days overdue). I attached the statement for reference.

We really value Cortex as a customer and want to avoid any interruption, so can you confirm:
- When we can expect payment for INV-2026-331 (EUR 61,500)?
- Whether INV-2027-015 (EUR 23,250) will be paid on the upcoming cycle?

If there are VAT/regulatory issues or paperwork needed on our side (reverse-charge, tax certificate), let me know and we’ll prioritize. If we don't see a plan by 17 Mar, we’ll need to escalate internally to the collections committee.

Attachments: [INV-2026-331.pdf (invoice), Cortex-statement-Feb2027.csv (account statement)]

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Martinez <elena.m@cortex.ai>

Cc: Cortex Billing <billing@cortex.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Overdue invoices: INV-2026-331 + outstanding balance

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the note. Apologies for the delay — we've been stuck in procurement. Two points: 
1) Finance is disputing the VAT handling on INV-2026-331; they say our region requires a reverse-charge and we need a vendor VAT certificate before we release the payment.
2) There's an internal PO mismatch on INV-2026-331 amount vs. the PO we issued. We're trying to reconcile, but it may take one more week.

We can do a partial payment of EUR 20,000 today to show good faith if that helps. Can you confirm that will be applied to the older invoice and that you'll pause any collection escalation while we sort the VAT docs?

Best,
Elena Martinez
Head of Finance Operations, Cortex AI
elena.m@cortex.ai

Subject: Internal: Cortex overdue — recommended path to final demand / legal prep

Team,

Summary: Cortex (DE/FR offices) is 90 days past on INV-2026-331 (EUR 61,500). They offered a EUR 20,000 immediate partial and say VAT docs + PO mismatch are blocking payment. They asked us to pause escalation while they produce paperwork.

Recommendation:
- Accept the EUR 20k partial and apply to INV-2026-331.
- Provide a 7-day extension for delivery of VAT certificate + corrected PO (deadline: 17 Mar COB).
- Prepare a brief settlement/final-demand letter if docs are not received, with two business-day cure period after notice. We should also prepare a standard service suspension notice as a last resort.

Markus — can Legal draft the settlement/final-demand template and confirm wording around VAT and reverse-charge? Laura — Collections committee would likely accept a 30-day payment plan post-confirmation; want your sign-off to present that as an option if they can’t clear everything by next week.

I’m prepared to escalate to our Head of Revenue if we don’t get remittance or docs by 17 Mar.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive

Subject: Re: Internal: Cortex overdue — recommended path to final demand / legal prep

Jordan — agree with your approach. A few operational notes:
- Apply the EUR 20k immediately and flag the remainder as 'in dispute' until we receive the VAT cert/PO.
- Collections committee approves offering a 30-day graduated payment plan: 25% up front, then 25% at 30d, 25% at 60d, 25% at 90d; requires a signed payment plan agreement.
- If docs are not provided by 17 Mar COB we issue the final-dunning letter and include a DocuSign for the payment plan; if they refuse, we begin temporary service suspension steps on day 10 after notice.

Markus — please prepare the final-dunning template and a short settlement letter focused on VAT evidence acceptance so we can avoid litigation.

Laura
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.m@cortex.ai>, Cortex Billing <billing@cortex.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 17:24:00 +00:00
Subject: Final notice and one-time payment plan offer — action required by 17 Mar

Elena —

Thanks for working with us. Per our internal review, we have prepared a final-dunning/settlement package to keep Cortex on the platform without service disruption. Key points:
- We applied the EUR 20,000 partial payment to INV-2026-331. Remaining balance: EUR 64,750 (includes INV-2027-015 and late fees per contract).
- Please deliver: vendor VAT certificate (EU VAT registration) and the corrected PO by 17 March 2027 COB.
- If documents are supplied by the deadline, we will place the remainder on a one-time 30-day graduated payment plan (25% due immediately via DocuSign, link below).
- If documents are not supplied, we will issue the formal final demand on 18 Mar and may commence temporary service suspension 10 calendar days after the demand.

Please review and sign the payment plan here (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-DEF-123

Attached: final-dunning-letter.pdf (formal notice), account statement.

If you have any legal or VAT questions, Markus from Legal is on the thread and can confirm we will accept standard EU VAT registration + reverse-charge confirmation while processing.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
